decision.rationale: TXN-008095 (43776 minor units EUR, QUAYSIDE GETAWAYS, MER-000034) is on card CRD-000060. It posted on 2026-07-27 and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-22. That is 87 days, inside the 120-day limit in time-limits. Its authorisation, AUTH-008286, shows entry mode ECOMMERCE, 3-D Secure AUTHENTICATED, CVV MATCH, response APPROVED and fraud flag false. Under unauthorised-3ds-authenticated, an online payment authenticated with 3-D Secure and not flagged for fraud is treated as made by the cardholder, and the matching CVV supports this. The card also has an earlier approved purchase at the same merchant: TXN-001899 on 2026-07-10. That adds weight but is not what decides the case. The cardholder says they do not recognise the payment and that the card never left them. For an online payment, having the card does not change the authentication result.

proposed_actions.reason: This was an online payment that was confirmed through 3-D Secure authentication, the card's security code matched, and the payment was not flagged as suspicious. Under our policy, a payment like this counts as made by the cardholder. You also made an earlier purchase from the same merchant on this card.
